description: This file defines a utility class HeaderTranslator for translating headers to and from external sources and internal representations within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for constructing header translators, filtering headers, and handling header definitions, primarily serving as a bridge between external headers (strings) and internal DittoHeaders objects, with special handling for known headers.

classes.name: HeaderTranslator
classes.description: A utility class for translating headers between external string maps and internal DittoHeaders objects, applying filtering based on header definitions, with various methods to construct, filter, and manipulate header data.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator instance with no known headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Constructs a HeaderTranslator from provided arrays of header definitions.

methods.name: fromExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts external headers (Map<String, String>) into a filtered set based on known header definitions.

methods.name: toExternalHeaders
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders into external headers as a Map, applying necessary filtering.

methods.name: retainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Filters external headers, retaining only those known to this translator.

methods.name: toExternalAndRetainKnownHeaders
methods.description: Converts DittoHeaders to external headers, filtering out unknown headers.

methods.name: forgetHeaderKeys
methods.description: Creates a new HeaderTranslator without certain header definitions. Deprecated.
